chapter_mission: Han and Leia on the Falcon carry the marriage arc forward — a quiet, pointed exchange that refuses to resolve. Centerpoint engineering confirmations deepen.
chapter_turn: The marriage becomes operationally bifurcated without emotional rupture — Han and Leia agree to disagree in a way that prefigures the end-of-book separation.

scene_plan.purpose: Han and Leia Falcon galley conversation — the political disagreement is named but not settled.
Leia in the cockpit alone — interior consolidation of her third-way posture.

exit_vector: Han and Leia both looking at the stars from opposite chairs, saying nothing.
notes: Allston handles the marriage strain with restraint — no shouting, no ultimatums, just a visible disagreement.
